name: commit-slice
context_rationale: Generates commit messages from vault files on disk; no interactive main-thread context needed except for the --merge/--push confirmation gates which are explicit checkpoints.
summary: Generates an audit-grade conventional commit message for a just-completed slice by reading vault artifacts (mission-brief.json, build-log.json, validation.json, reflection.json, ADRs). Dispatches message rendering to a Haiku subagent for cost efficiency. Supports three mutually exclusive execution modes: --merge, --push, and --sync-after-pr. Default mode generates and displays the message only.

reads.purpose: Source of slice intent and acceptance criteria count for commit message
Critic blocker count and addressed status
Per-AC PASS/FAIL and shippability regression status
Find new ADRs referencing the current slice

outputs.purpose: Append PCR auto-resolution and PCR-2b breadcrumb events to Events section
Audit log of PCR auto-resolutions and HARD resolution records
Per-slice audit record of what the slice changed (JSON twin of the commit message); written in no-flag/--merge/--push via write_changelog.py (Step 4.5). Never written to the code repo root.

agents.name: code-review
agents.when: PCR-2b HARD/MIXED rebase conflict gate (Step 5b) — after user resolves conflict markers and --verify-resolution passes CLEAN
agents.purpose: Review the resolved conflict diff for lost-hunk/dropped-side, both-sides-intent preservation, semantic correctness, stray markers, and vault/ADR contradiction

tools.name: stale_branch_classifier
tools.purpose: Classify slice/* branches as orphan (worktree-less) or legitimate concurrent slice; gates --merge and --push pre-flight

tools.name: parallel_conflict_resolver
tools.purpose: Attempt auto-resolution of SOFT/VAULT_CLAIM rebase conflicts during PSQ-3 rebase in --merge flow

tools.name: write_changelog
tools.purpose: Write the per-slice changelog.json into the archived slice folder from the Step 2 record + Step 4 subject (Step 4.5)

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read mission-brief.json, build-log.json, validation.json, reflection.json, critique.json, shippability.json from target slice folder

harness_tools.name: Glob
harness_tools.purpose: Find most recently archived slice folder and new ADRs referencing the slice

harness_tools.name: Grep
harness_tools.purpose: Find ADRs referencing the current slice (grep -l 'slice: slice-NNN')

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Run git status, add, commit, merge, rebase, push, branch, log, worktree, ls-remote, cherry, fetch

harness_tools.name: Agent
harness_tools.purpose: Dispatch to Haiku subagent for commit message template rendering; dispatch code-review subagent for PCR-2b HARD/MIXED resolution verification

harness_tools.name: AskUserQuestion
harness_tools.purpose: TRI-RESOLVE-1 structured three-option gate for HARD/MIXED conflict resolution; confirmation checkpoints before git state changes
